title: A01 Broken Access Control
author: owasp.org
summary: Broken access control is a common security flaw where users can act beyond their allowed permissions, risking data exposure and unauthorized actions. Attackers exploit this by modifying requests, guessing URLs, or bypassing front-end controls to access or change data. To prevent this, access control must be enforced on the server side with strict rules, logging, and proper token management.
